definitions.action: One common offset to the four wheel targets in each closed-loop rollout (rad/s).
definitions.return_m: R_H = -mean(abs(x[t] - native_x_at_reset)), t=1..H; the same origin for both sources.
definitions.autograd: Archived zero-offset H32 model derivative of the return in m/(rad/s).
definitions.primary_horizon: Last common 20 ms endpoint strictly before the earliest native termination.
definitions.return_difference_mm: Positive minus negative return; time-averaged absolute drift improvement in mm.
definitions.dependence: Each seed has its own actor and model. The two radii reuse a cell, the three resets recur for all seeds, and all horizons reuse trajectory prefixes. Only the common wheel direction is probed.
